name: UZDoom
description: The modern GZDoom-lineage engine with advanced rendering and mod support. On this vendor-kernel phone it runs with the software renderer because there is no usable /dev/dri node. Compare its map detail and menu depth with Nuxel Doom and Chocolate Doom.

nuxel.source: Native Doom engine comparison launcher; no commercial WAD bundled
features: Software renderer for the S10+ kernel
Optional comparison path, not the touch default
